scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
scripts.build: pnpm content:build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm --filter @neolab/web build
scripts.balance:smoke: pnpm content:build >/dev/null && pnpm --filter @neolab/balance-runner exec node src/cli.ts --runs 30 --max-ticks 104 --matrix paired --output ../../artifacts/balance/smoke
scripts.balance:horizon: pnpm content:build >/dev/null && pnpm --filter @neolab/balance-runner exec node src/cli.ts --runs 10 --max-ticks 1120 --matrix independent --trace-sample-rate 0.1 --output ../../artifacts/balance/horizon
scripts.balance:endings: pnpm content:build >/dev/null && pnpm --filter @neolab/balance-runner exec node src/cli.ts --runs 70 --max-ticks 1120 --matrix paired --core-strategies --trace-sample-rate 0 --output ../../artifacts/balance/endings
scripts.balance:full: pnpm content:build >/dev/null && pnpm --filter @neolab/balance-runner exec node src/cli.ts --runs 1000 --max-ticks 520 --output ../../artifacts/balance/full
scripts.balance:release: pnpm content:build >/dev/null && pnpm --filter @neolab/balance-runner exec node src/cli.ts --runs 10200 --max-ticks 520 --matrix cartesian --output ../../artifacts/balance/release-shard
scripts.balance:aggregate: pnpm content:build >/dev/null && pnpm --filter @neolab/balance-runner exec node src/aggregate-cli.ts
scripts.balance:sweep: pnpm content:build >/dev/null && pnpm --filter @neolab/balance-runner exec node src/sweep-cli.ts
scripts.package:itch:alpha: pnpm content:build && NEOLAB_BASE_PATH=./ pnpm --filter @neolab/web build && pnpm --filter @neolab/release-tools itch:package
scripts.package:itch: pnpm content:build && pnpm content:check && pnpm content:branches && NEOLAB_BASE_PATH=./ pnpm --filter @neolab/web build && pnpm --filter @neolab/release-tools itch:package && pnpm --filter @neolab/release-tools release:audit -- --output artifacts/itch/release-checks
scripts.release:check: pnpm content:build && pnpm content:check && pnpm content:branches && pnpm --filter @neolab/web build && pnpm release:check-built
